papers.title_en: PosePlaner: Denoising Any Feed-Forward Pose Predictor from Pairwise Planar Geometry
papers.authors: Yihang Chen, Bin Tan, Yujun Shen, Yinghao Xu, Nan Xue
papers.evidence: 针对DUSt3R、VGGT等前馈多视图Transformer进行几何引导的位姿修正
papers.tldr: 多视角Transformer以单次前向计算完成三维重建，却将对应关系、几何与位姿紧密耦合，难以在测试时依据几何证据纠正错误。PosePlaner将位姿精炼建模为条件生成：输入粗略几何匹配和初始位姿，通过流匹配生成多个位姿假设并融合。模型仅用双视图数据训练，就能作为周期性精炼器接入流式多视角估计，无需重新训练。实验表明，它能修正前馈预测失败、改善对应关系求解并减少长序列累积漂移，为端到端位姿预测引入数据驱动的几何校正机制。
papers.abstract_en: Recent multi-view Transformers (e.g., DUSt3R and VGGT) have advanced 3D reconstruction by scaling training data and model capacity from two views to many views and long sequences, subsuming the classical SfM/SLAM pipeline of feature extraction, matching, and pose estimation in a single feed-forward pass. Yet this subsumption hides the interfaces between pipeline stages---correspondences, geometry, and pose are entangled in a single forward pass, leaving supervised fine-tuning as the major path to improvement and offering no mechanism to correct predictions from geometric evidence at test time. We propose PosePlaner to close this gap by reviving the classical coupling between correspondences and pose via flow matching, treating pose refinement as a conditional generation problem that takes coarse geometric matches and initial pose as input condition and fuses the resulting pose hypotheses into a single refined estimate, providing a continuous, data-driven analog of RANSAC voting. Our method is trained efficiently on two-view data, yet serves as a periodic refiner for streaming n-view pose estimators with no retraining. Empirically, it corrects failures of feed-forward predictors, substantially improves correspondence-based solvers, and reduces accumulated drift in long streaming sequences.

papers.title_en: CADonatello: Towards Real-World Multi-Part 3D CAD Reconstruction
papers.authors: Ahmet Serdar Karadeniz, Dimitrios Mallis, Parsa Akbari Chianeh, Kseniya Cherenkova, Anis Kacem, Djamila Aouada
papers.evidence: 从真实扫描分割结构部件并逐件重建参数化CAD模型
papers.tldr: 真实场景中的三维扫描常含噪声，物体也往往由多个部件组成；以单部件模型和干净几何训练的方法因此难以可靠重建。CADonatello先借助大规模三维部件分割模型识别结构组件，再逐部件从截面参数化草图并拉伸生成CAD。为适应扫描截面，还构建了CC3D Cross-Sections配对数据集，支持从干净草图图像向真实扫描截面的领域适配。实验显示，该框架在噪声扫描及多个真实世界基准上表现更稳健，为复杂多部件对象的参数化CAD逆向重建提供了有效方案。
papers.abstract_en: Existing methods for CAD reconstruction from 3D scans achieve strong performance on standard benchmarks, yet their effectiveness often degrades in real-world scenarios where objects consist of multiple parts and scan artifacts such as noise. A key reason is that current CAD reconstruction datasets predominantly contain single-part models and clean geometric inputs, limiting the ability of learned models to generalize to realistic settings. In this work, we introduce CADonatello, a part-aware framework for reconstructing parametric CAD models from real-world 3D scans. Our approach first decomposes the input geometry into structurally meaningful components using a foundation-scale 3D part segmentation model, and then reconstructs each component independently through a cross-section-driven pipeline that performs sketch parameterization followed by an extrusion. To improve the robustness of sketch parameterization to scan-derived cross-sections, we further introduce CC3D Cross-Sections, a dataset of paired rasterized cross-section images from realistic scans and their corresponding parametric sketches derived from aligned CAD models. This dataset enables effective domain adaptation from clean CAD sketch images to scan-derived cross-section images. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed approach improves generalization to noisy scans and enables reliable reconstruction of complex multi-part objects across multiple real-world CAD reverse engineering benchmarks.

papers.title_en: FreeView: Robust 3D Reconstruction from Uncurated Views
papers.authors: Junho Kim, Hyunyoung Choi, Seongwon Lee
papers.evidence: 改进未整理多视图输入下的前馈式三维重建
papers.tldr: 从未筛选的图像集合重建一致三维场景，常因无关视角或视角间缺乏重叠而失效；既有基于参考图的过滤方法又要求预先提供干净参考。FreeView提出无需训练的联合方案，先利用集合级共识选出代表视图，再结合互补的视觉与几何证据，针对每个集合筛除干扰视图。该方法在外观和视点变化较大时仍能保留有用视图，并有效拒绝干扰视图。它可接入VGGT与pi^3，实验显示干净视图保留率和干扰剔除率均较高，使非整理图像集合也能支持可靠三维重建。
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing a coherent 3D scene from uncurated image collections remains challenging due to the presence of irrelevant or non-overlapping views. Recent work has shown that feed-forward reconstruction models contain internal view-consistency signals that support distractor rejection. However, reference-conditioned filtering relies on a curated clean reference, which is not guaranteed in practical image collections. To address this limitation, we introduce FreeView, a training-free framework that jointly selects a filtering reference and rejects distractor views from an uncurated collection. FreeView leverages collection-level consensus to identify a representative view that serves as a reliable reference for filtering. It then adapts view rejection to each input collection by combining complementary visual and geometric evidence. This approach preserves useful views under substantial appearance and viewpoint variations while rejecting distractors. FreeView integrates with both VGGT and pi^3, removing the need for a manually curated reference or manual calibration of view rejection. Extensive experiments across multiple datasets demonstrate high clean-view retention and distractor rejection rates, leading to reliable 3D reconstruction from uncurated views.

papers.title_en: ScheNav: Schematic-Guided Object Goal Navigation
papers.authors: Guichen Huang, Chenchen Jing, Che Sun, Yuwei Wu, Yunde Jia
papers.evidence: 具身智能体利用示意地图在室内环境中探索并导航至目标物体
papers.tldr: 复杂环境中的目标导航要求智能体探索并抵达指定物体，而人类常用草图、方位标注等低成本示意图辅助判断。本文构建Furnished-RPLAN，包含逾3.3万种带家具布局、导航任务及可控噪声示意图，并提出ScheNav闭环框架。其SchemaField融合示意图与累积观测，预测并随探索更新空间价值场，以支持探索和停止决策。实验显示，该方法在多类示意图、目标椭圆和指向信息下提升成功率与路径效率，对测试中的扰动和缺失也具备容忍度；仅用模拟平面图训练即可迁移至未见环境。
papers.abstract_en: Object goal navigation requires an embodied agent to locate and reach target objects in complex environments. Humans often rely on low-cost yet informative schematic maps, such as rough sketches or directional annotations. We develop a workflow for schematic-guided embodied navigation with two components: a training-data generation pipeline and ScheNav, a closed-loop navigation framework. Our lightweight data-generation pipeline turns 2D floorplans into navigation training environments, yielding Furnished-RPLAN, a dataset of over 33k furnished layouts with paired navigation episodes and noise-controllable schematic maps. ScheNav turns rough schematic guidance into exploration and stopping decisions by using SchemaField, a learned spatial module that fuses the guidance with accumulated observations and predicts spatial value fields. The framework updates these fields as exploration proceeds, with trajectory-based training and a cross-frame consistency objective supporting coherent guidance across changing viewpoints. ScheNav learns to use schematic guidance entirely from simulated floorplans and transfers this ability to unseen embodied environments. Experiments show improved navigation success and path efficiency across schematic maps, goal ellipses, and pointed directions, together with tolerance to the tested schematic perturbations and omissions. Together, these results demonstrate that rough schematic guidance offers a practical way to improve embodied navigation.

papers.title_en: SG-Splat: Stable Geometry Learning under Pose Uncertainty for Pose-Free 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.authors: Xiaohan Lu, Jiaqi Zhang, Weijia Jiang, Siwei Ma
papers.evidence: 改进无位姿前馈三维场景重建的几何稳定性
papers.tldr: 无位姿前馈式三维高斯泼溅可直接从未标定图像重建场景，但残余相机位姿误差会扰动规范坐标变换，给几何与属性学习带来噪声。SG-Splat将几何估计与高斯属性预测分支解耦，并以光流引导位姿细化、残差引导几何校正逐步提升对齐。训练时混合真实与预测位姿，兼顾属性监督清洁和几何抗误差能力。在DL3DV与RealEstate10K上，方法在新视角合成和位姿估计均达当前最佳，展示了提升位姿不确定场景重建稳定性的价值。
papers.abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has become a promising representation for real-time novel view synthesis and 3D scene reconstruction. For practical deployment, recent studies have explored pose-free feed-forward 3DGS, which reconstructs Gaussian representations directly from unposed input images. However, these methods remain sensitive to residual pose errors, which perturb canonical-space Gaussian transformation, introducing noisy supervision for geometry and attribute learning. To address this problem, we present SG-Splat, a pose-free feed-forward 3DGS framework that improves robustness to pose uncertainty and stabilizes the learning of Gaussian primitives. SG-Splat decouples geometry estimation and Gaussian attribute prediction into two dedicated branches, reducing error coupling between pose-sensitive geometry and Gaussian attributes. We further introduce a coarse-to-fine refinement pipeline, consisting of Flow-Guided Pose Refinement (FGPR) and Residual-Guided Geometry Correction (RGC), to improve geometric alignment before Gaussian attribute reconstruction. Specifically, FGPR refines camera poses with flow-based correlation features and differentiable bundle adjustment. RGC then corrects initial point maps using depth residuals derived from FGPR, producing more reliable Gaussian centers. To stabilize training, we introduce a dual-path strategy that mixes ground-truth and predicted poses for canonical transformation. It provides clean supervision for Gaussian attributes while improving geometry robustness to residual pose errors. Extensive experiments on DL3DV and RealEstate10K show that SG-Splat achieves state-of-the-art performance in both novel view synthesis and pose estimation.

papers.title_en: Synthetic Deformable Tubular Benchmark: A mechanically annotated dataset for evaluating deformable 3D reconstruction
papers.authors: Íñigo Cirauqui-Viloria
papers.evidence: 基准直接评估可变形三维重建及相机运动
papers.tldr: 可变形三维重建的评估需要同时掌握相机运动、表面形变、材料点对应关系与图像外观，而真实场景难以提供完整真值。本文借助开源工具 LumenMorph 构建合成管状场景基准，发布 5,580 张图像，覆盖多种表面运动、相机运动及有限元动作和外观变体。数据提供相机位姿、几何、深度、形变场、持久材料对应及有限元记录，并以独立检查验证标注一致性。结构光束法、光流和位移插值实验展示其区分配准覆盖与几何精度、分析运动影响及检验力学先验的能力，为可复现评测和基准扩展提供受控资源，但不宣称具备解剖或临床真实性。
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating deformable 3D reconstruction requires ground truth linking camera motion, surface deformation, material correspondence and image appearance. We introduce the Synthetic Deformable Tubular Benchmark, generated with LumenMorph, an open-source toolkit for creating, annotating and evaluating tubular scenes. The release contains 5,580 RGB images. Its baseline crosses three surface-motion conditions with moving and stationary cameras in six scene families; matched appearance variants cover only moving-camera finite-element actions in four families. Documented public and evaluation interfaces expose camera poses, geometry, depth, deformation fields, persistent material correspondences and discrete finite-element records. Persistent triangle identities and material weights let users track the same surface location across frames and query its three-dimensional trajectory. Separately implemented geometric and mechanical checks assess annotation consistency with the generating models. Structure-from-motion, optical-flow and supplied-geometry displacement-interpolation studies demonstrate how the resource distinguishes registration coverage from geometric accuracy, exposes camera- and surface-motion effects, and tests the benefits and mismatch of mechanical priors. Public readers, evaluation contracts and the configurable generator support reuse and extension. Data integrity, fixed-environment repeatability and retained-prediction score replay have distinct verification scopes. The benchmark provides a controlled synthetic reference without claiming anatomical or clinical realism.

papers.title_en: POD-RoPE: Rotary Position Encoding over Physical Observation Distributions for Embodied AI
papers.authors: Xiaodi Huang, Zilin Wang, Jinpeng Liu, Pengchuan Xiao, Zhenlei Shao, Zhang Zhang, Shuxiang Lu
papers.evidence: 为具身感知中的空间及时间观测范围设计位置表示
papers.tldr: 具身感知的位置表示不仅要编码几何位置，还需描述相机观测在空间与时间上的覆盖范围。论文提出POD-RoPE，将令牌观测足迹建模为相机中心、视线方向和采样时间的分布，并用旋转统计指导查询、键匹配及值与输出变换。接入Fast-WAM后，50项仿真任务平均成功率从91.83%升至92.88%，两项真实机器人任务从32.5%升至52.5%。该方法在多类任务与架构上验证有效，且比两种位置编码基线更快，为几何感知注意力提供了高效方案。
papers.abstract_en: Embodied perception requires positional representations that capture both physical geometry and the spatial and temporal extent of observations. We introduce POD-RoPE (Physical Observation Distribution RoPE), which represents token observation footprints as distributions over camera centers, viewing directions, and sampling times. Under independent sampling, expected rotations encode relative relationships between distributions; when each distribution collapses to a single address, the construction recovers pointwise RoPE. The same rotation statistics support Q/K matching and coherence-dependent V/O transformations, allowing observation geometry to guide both information selection and content aggregation. Per-token pre-aggregation avoids increasing sequence length or processing pairs of observation nodes. We evaluate POD-RoPE across four robot policy architectures, simulation and real-world manipulation, and complementary reconstruction, depth-estimation, and novel-view-synthesis tasks. Integrating POD-RoPE into Fast-WAM improves mean success from 91.83% to 92.88% across all 50 RoboTwin 2.0 tasks, and from 32.5% to 52.5% on two real-robot tasks on Sharpa North. Controlled reconstruction ablations support the contributions of distribution encoding and V/O transformations. In H20 model-block benchmarks, POD-RoPE achieves median forward-plus-backward speedups of $1.91\times$ over P-RoPE and $5.34\times$ over RayRoPE, with a median latency overhead of 17.4% over Standard RoPE. These results support physical observation distributions as an effective and computationally efficient basis for geometry-aware attention.

papers.title_en: Lightweight Change Detection for Adaptive Collective Perception in Dynamic Environments
papers.authors: Thiemen Siemensma, Tiago Travassos, Jiacheng Zhang, Bahar Haghighat
papers.evidence: 机器人群体依据分布式观测感知环境，并适应环境变化
papers.tldr: 群体机器人常通过分布式观察判断黑白瓦片环境的多数类型，但既有研究多假设环境静态；瓦片比例和表面空间相关性改变会使旧信念失效、采样偏差加剧。本文将轻量级变化检测嵌入贝叶斯集体决策，在检测到分布漂移后重置机器人信念，并在线识别空间相关采样、调整采样间隔。Webots仿真表明，该方法检测延迟有竞争力，在不同通信设置下精度更一致，也能在相关性变化时提高决策准确率。其常数内存与每样本常数计算降低部署负担，为资源受限机器人提供适应动态环境的集体感知方案。
papers.abstract_en: Swarm robotics enables scalable inspection through collective perception, where robots infer environmental properties from distributed observations. A common benchmark considers robots exploring black-white tiled environments and determining the majority tile type. While most work studies static environments, dynamic environments remain underexplored. We study collective perception in dynamic environments where the tile proportion and the spatial correlation of surface patterns may change over time. To enable implementation on resource-constrained robots, we integrate a lightweight change detection mechanism into a Bayesian collective decision-making framework that resets robot beliefs when distribution shifts are detected. The proposed detector requires constant memory and constant per-sample computation, unlike two recent competitive approaches that store the full sample stream, making it suitable for memory-constrained robots. We further introduce a method that detects spatially correlated sampling and adapts sampling intervals online to mitigate correlation effects. Our simulation results in Webots show competitive change detection delays, more consistent precision across communication settings, and improved decision accuracy under changing spatial correlations.

papers.title_en: Learning Scene Coordinate Reconstruction from Unposed Images via Pose Graph Optimization
papers.authors: Tze Ho Elden Tse, Jizong Peng, Angela Yao
papers.evidence: 由场景坐标约束优化相机位姿的学习式重建
papers.tldr: 无序图像上的学习式结构运动方法可估计相机位姿与场景坐标，但缺少全局及多视图一致性约束，在复杂或歧义场景中易发生位姿漂移和错位。本文将位姿图优化融入 ACE-Zero，从预测场景坐标中构造相对位姿约束，并结合极线与光流一致性估计置信度，开展不确定性感知优化。结果表明，该框架提升位姿估计的鲁棒性与准确性，并抑制错误修正。研究说明，全局几何推理能够补足学习式推断，为无真值监督的重建提供更可靠的优化方案。
papers.abstract_en: Learning-based structure-from-motion methods such as ACE-Zero have demonstrated strong performance in estimating cameraposes and scene coordinates from unordered image collections without requiring ground truth supervision. However, the lack of global and multi-view consistency constraints in ACE-Zero can lead to pose drift and misalignment, particularly in complex or ambiguous scenes. In this work, we propose a hybrid framework that integrates pose graph optimization (PGO) into ACE-Zero to refine camera poses and suppress incorrect refinements. We construct pose graphs directly from ACE-Zero outputs by extracting relative pose constraints from predicted scene coordinates. Furthermore, we introduce an uncertainty-aware optimization strategy by estimating confidence scores using geometric priors, including epipolar and optical flow consistencies across views. Our approach improves the robustness and accuracy of pose estimation, demonstrating that global geometric reasoning can effectively complement learning-based inference in structure-from-motion.

papers.title_en: Generative Structure from Motion with Native 3D Diffusion
papers.authors: Haobin Duan, Binbin Huang, Mochu Xiang, Yiqun Zhao, Zibo Zhao, Yi Ma, Shenghua Gao
papers.evidence: 多视图三维重建结合扩散变换器与相机运动估计
papers.tldr: 从少量未标定图像恢复物体三维结构与相机运动时，传统方法难以推断不可见区域，单纯生成又未必忠于输入，串联两者还会累积误差。GenSfM以原生三维扩散联合处理重建和生成，通过多模态扩散变换器共享注意力，协同去噪形状与逐视角位姿，并利用观测图像约束几何、以物体先验补全缺失部分。其紧凑的三维紫外体积表示支持增加视角，位姿感知阶段进一步细化几何和纹理。在Toys4k与GSO的四视图实验中，新视角峰值信噪比提升3.2至4.5分贝，倒角距离降低2.8至3.8倍，输入位姿五度内准确率超过百分之九十六。该方法无需外部位姿估计、后处理优化或已知相机内参，为少视图三维恢复提供兼顾图像一致性与未观测区域补全的统一方案。
papers.abstract_en: Recovering an object's 3D structure and camera motion from a few uncalibrated views is a fundamental problem in computer vision. Classical structure from motion methods recover 3D geometry consistent with the input images but cannot recover unseen regions; native generation methods produce plausible 3D objects which are related but not necessarily faithful to the input images. Methods simply concatenating reconstruction and generation allow error to cascade across the two stages, instead of producing a 3D object consistent with both the distribution and the input. We propose GenSfM, which integrates image-based 3D reconstruction with a native 3D diffusion model. In particular, we use a multi-modal diffusion transformer to jointly denoise the shape latent and per-view pose latents under shared self-attention, grounding generated geometry in the observed views while using object-level priors to infer unobserved regions. A compact 3D-native UV-volume tokenization keeps the joint sequence small as views are added, and a pose-aware stage refines geometry and texture by sampling per-voxel image features at the recovered camera poses. On Toys4k and GSO, for $4$ uncalibrated views, GenSfM improves novel-view PSNR by $3.2$-$4.5$ dB and reduces median Chamfer distance by $2.8$-$3.8\times$ over a strong native-3D generation baseline, while recovering input-view poses over $96\%$ Acc@$5^\circ$ without any external pose-estimation backbone, post-hoc optimization, or known intrinsics. Project page: https://dotb1ue.github.io/GenSfm/.

papers.title_en: Cross-Scale Sparse Attention for Referring Segmentation in Remote Sensing
papers.authors: Yuxi Li, Lu Si, Xia Liao, Yidong Shen, Zheng Wei, Jun Zhang, Xin Yuan
papers.evidence: 联合建模跨尺度视觉层级与多粒度指代分割
papers.tldr: 高分辨率遥感影像中的目标细小且分布稀疏，依据自然语言进行精确分割还需处理跨尺度视觉层级与复杂指代关系。论文提出跨尺度稀疏注意力模型CSSAM，以跨尺度模态对齐融合模块统一融合视觉与文本特征，并用动态多模态稀疏混合注意力筛选关键信息。作者同时构建覆盖多目标、依赖式多跳推理及多粒度描述的M³RRSIS-D数据集。实验在该数据集和两个公开基准上取得有竞争力表现，尤其关注细粒度推理与高交并比定位，为真实遥感指代分割提供模型与评测资源。
papers.abstract_en: High-resolution remote sensing (RS) imagery provides fine spatial detail over large areas, making it essential for fine-grained scene understanding. Referring Remote Sensing Image Segmentation (RRSIS) aims to segment regions described by natural language, yet many existing methods rely on sequential alignment--fusion pipelines with limited joint modeling of cross-scale visual hierarchies and linguistic dependencies. Moreover, dense attention mechanisms struggle with the sparsity and wide spatial dispersion of RS targets, while current datasets offer limited structured evaluation of multi-target references, multi-hop relational reasoning, and multi-granularity descriptions, limiting both model development and evaluation. To address these challenges, we propose a Cross-Scale Sparse Attention Model (CSSAM), which aligns multiscale visual features with complex referring expressions through two key modules. The Cross-scale Modality-aligned Fusion Module (CMFM) performs unified cross-scale cross-modal fusion, while the Dynamic Multimodal Sparse Hybrid Attention (DMSHA) selectively attends to informative visual--textual tokens, reducing dense visual interactions. Furthermore, we introduce M$^{3}$RRSIS-D, a RRSIS dataset explicitly designed around three core reasoning dimensions: multi-target (M$^{1}$), reference-dependent multi-hop (M$^{2}$), and multi-granularity (M$^{3}$) expressions. Extensive experiments on M$^{3}$RRSIS-D and two public RRSIS benchmarks demonstrate that CSSAM achieves competitive performance across accuracy, fine-grained reasoning, and high-IoU localization metrics, validating its effectiveness for complex semantic reasoning in realistic RS scenarios. Code, dataset, and model weights will be released upon acceptance.

papers.title_en: RelateGS: Reliable Semantic and Relational Evidence for 3D Scene Understanding with Gaussian Splatting
papers.authors: Seongjun Choi, Sangyoun Lee
papers.evidence: 在三维重建场景中增强语义关系理解与视觉定位
papers.tldr: 语言感知三维高斯溅射推动了基于语言的场景理解，但关系定位不仅取决于是否表示语义和关系，也取决于场景证据是否可靠、充分。多视角语义聚合可能纳入弱观测，而相机轨迹还可能未充分观察关键对象关系，导致目标消歧困难。RelateGS在语义特征提升时抑制不可靠观测，并将多视角对象观测整合为持久三维图；图中识别证据不足的关系后，针对性重查已有信息帧以补充证据。在Sr3D+与Nr3D上，其Acc@0.25分别比此前最佳高7.9和1.7个百分点，体现了结构化、可靠证据对三维视觉定位的价值。
papers.abstract_en: Language-aware 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has advanced language-driven 3D scene understanding by incorporating semantic and relational cues into reconstructed scenes. However, relation-aware grounding depends not only on representing such information, but also on whether the underlying scene-side evidence is reliable and sufficient. Multi-view semantic aggregation can incorporate weak observations, while object relations can remain under-observed along the available camera trajectory, leading to ambiguous evidence for target disambiguation. We present RelateGS, a structured language-aware Gaussian representation that selectively refines semantic and relational evidence for 3D visual grounding. RelateGS suppresses unreliable observations during semantic feature uplifting and consolidates multi-view object observations into a persistent 3D graph. The graph further identifies under-observed object relations and guides targeted re-querying of informative existing frames to complement their evidence. Experiments on Sr3D+ and Nr3D demonstrate competitive 3D grounding performance, improving the previous best by 7.9 and 1.7 percentage points at Acc@0.25, respectively.

papers.title_en: Hybrid Mamba-Transformer Network for Single-Shot 3D Reconstruction from Fringe Patterns
papers.authors: Xinjie Zhou, XiaoLei Li
papers.evidence: 由单幅条纹图像回归表面高度，执行三维表面重建
papers.tldr: 条纹投影轮廓术可用单幅图像快速重建三维表面，但高频条纹下的高度恢复仍难兼顾全局空间一致性与局部几何细节。为此，论文构建混合 Mamba-Transformer 网络，在 Swin U 形架构的中分辨率编码阶段加入视觉状态空间建模，并设计 ADVSS 块结合局部、膨胀、轴向卷积与四向扫描。公开数据集实验中，模型取得 0.548 mm RMSE 和 0.9985 SSIM，RMSE 较 UHRNet、HiDNet 分别降低 65.2% 和 59.6%。结果表明，该设计能有效融合长程依赖建模与细节保留，提升单幅条纹三维重建精度。
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning facilitates rapid single shot three dimensional (3D) reconstruction using fringe projection profilometry (FPP), but recovering accurate surface height from a single high frequency fringe image remains challenging because both long-range spatial consistency and fine geometric details must be preserved. Convolutional networks are limited in modeling long range dependencies, whereas window-based Transformers establish global interactions only progressively with increasing depth. To address these limitations, a hybrid Mamba Transformer network is proposed for fringe to height regression. The network adopts a Swin based U shaped architecture and introduces visual state space modeling at the intermediate resolution encoder stage. An axial and dilated vision state space (ADVSS) block is further developed to enhance prescan feature encoding through local, dilated, and axial depthwise convolutions while retaining four directional selective scanning. This design combines linear complexity long range modeling with direction aware preservation of local fringe structures. Experiments on a publicly available FPP dataset show that the proposed method outperforms hNet, SwinConvUNet, UHRNet, and HiDNet in mean absolute error(MAE), root mean square error (RMSE), absolute relative error, and structural similarity index measure (SSIM). Using only one deformed fringe image, the proposed method achieves an RMSE of 0.548 mm and an SSIM of 0.9985, reducing RMSE by 65.2% and 59.6% relative to UHRNet and HiDNet, respectively. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of combining selective state space modeling with hierarchical window based attention for accurate single-shot FPP reconstruction.

papers.title_en: VISTA: Active Exploration for Self-Improvement in Embodied Agents
papers.authors: Zhang Zhang, Shengjun Zhang, Simin Huang, Min Chen, Chong Xia, Xin Fei, Yueqi Duan
papers.evidence: 具身智能体通过交互探索并迭代改进自身能力
papers.tldr: 具身智能体要在开放、动态的物理环境中完成任务，表现不仅取决于基础模型，也依赖执行工具链；现有方法多根据静态轨迹事后反思，却缺少主动测试更新的环节。VISTA提出元智能体框架，以工具链图记录候选版本及其谱系，复用有效机制并避开失败方向。每轮从已有版本和执行证据出发，主动生成环境交互轨迹，探查失败与恢复行为，再据新证据修改并重新评估工具链。在LIBERO-Pro、RoboCasa和RoboTwin上，VISTA逐步提升成功率，且比静态反思更省模拟器轨迹，推动工具链改进由离线推断走向交互验证。
papers.abstract_en: Agentic embodied intelligence plays a foundational role in open-ended, dynamic physical environments. Rather than treating policy learning as an end-to-end mapping from instructions to actions, recent studies reveal that embodied systems depend not only on pre-trained foundation models, but also on harness. Prior approaches largely treat rollouts as static logs for post-hoc reflection, producing harness updates without autonomously testing and refining them through subsequent embodied interaction. To address this challenge, we propose VISTA, a meta-agent framework that transforms post-hoc rollout reflection into active self-exploration for embodied harness improvement. Specifically, VISTA maintains a harness graph that records the lineage of proposed harnesses, which enables the meta-agent to retrieve prior hypotheses, build on effective mechanisms, and avoid repeatedly exploring failed directions. Each iteration begins from a retained harness version and its execution evidence. Rather than directly committing an update from these historical trajectories, the meta-agent actively explores in the environment. It autonomously generates new rollouts, probes execution failures and recovery behaviors, and iteratively modifies the harness based on the resulting evidence. The refined harness is then evaluated afresh and added to the harness graph. We evaluate VISTA on the LIBERO-Pro, RoboCasa, and RoboTwin benchmarks. Experimental results demonstrate that VISTA progressively improves task success and is more rollout-efficient than static reflection, achieving higher success rates with fewer simulator rollouts.

papers.title_en: CVTSplat: Multi-view Reconstruction Using an Adaptive Centroidal Voronoi Tessellation
papers.authors: Briac Toussaint, Diego Thomas, Jean-Sébastien Franco, Edmond Boyer, Christian Theobalt
papers.evidence: 从多视图图像进行形状与外观重建，采用自适应空间剖分
papers.tldr: 多视图图像重建需要兼顾表面几何精度与优化效率，但传统Voronoi划分产生的不规则单元，会增加迭代重建划分的开销。CVTSplat采用自适应质心Voronoi剖分，根据演化中的有符号距离场调整单元尺寸，让采样点集中于零水平集附近，同时保持单元规则。围绕小而近各向同性的单元，系统设计了GPU近邻查询、近似Voronoi构造和专用光栅化器。实验显示其在DTU与BlendedMVS上达到有竞争力的几何精度，单GPU训练约2.5分钟，划分构造快5至10倍。
papers.abstract_en: Voronoi tessellations have recently emerged as an adaptive, space-partitioning discretization for shape and appearance reconstruction from multi-view images. However, the irregular cells they produce make the repeated reconstruction of the tessellation during optimization costly. We therefore explore adaptive centroidal Voronoi tessellations (CVTs), which extend standard CVTs with non-uniform cell sizes while preserving the regular, well-shaped cells that make them efficient to compute. In CVTSplat, cell size is modulated by the evolving signed distance field, concentrating sites near the zero level set while keeping cells nearly centroidal. This regularity lets us specialize the whole pipeline, with GPU algorithms for nearest-neighbor queries and approximate Voronoi construction, and a rasterizer tailored to small, nearly isotropic cells. Our Voronoi construction is 5 to 10 times faster than general-purpose alternatives in this regime. On DTU and BlendedMVS, CVTSplat reaches geometric accuracy competitive with the best Gaussian-splatting surface methods while training in about 2.5 minutes on a single GPU.

papers.title_en: E3tereo: Improving Stereo Matching at Depth Boundaries with Learned Geometric Edges
papers.authors: Qi Xiong, Qinghua Zhao, Yongqiang Xi
papers.evidence: 学习几何边缘以改进立体深度边界处的视差估计
papers.tldr: 立体匹配的深度边界容易产生显著视差误差：在Scene Flow上，IGEV中几何边缘像素仅占评估像素的6%，却约占总绝对视差误差的一半，而光度边缘还可能把纹理变化误当作深度边界。E3Stereo从视差监督中学习几何边缘，结合骨干视差与图像细节预测全分辨率修正，并用边缘图突出边界训练误差、联合优化边缘预测器。它在Scene Flow上使RAFT-Stereo、IGEV和MonSter的边界端点误差降低9.5%—14.3%，整体误差也下降；微调后的IGEV模型在ETH3D、KITTI 2012和KITTI 2015的11项指标上均优于原模型。结果表明，针对几何边界建模可改善边界与整体匹配表现。
papers.abstract_en: Depth boundaries remain a major source of error in stereo matching. For IGEV on Scene Flow, geometric edge pixels account for only 6% of evaluated pixels but about half of the total absolute disparity error. Photometric edges can respond to texture changes without corresponding depth discontinuities, making them unreliable cues for boundary refinement. We propose E3Stereo, which learns geometric edges from disparity supervision and combines these boundary cues with the backbone disparity and image details to predict full-resolution disparity corrections. The same edge map also emphasizes boundary errors during training, while joint optimization allows the edge predictor to adapt to disparity refinement. On the Scene Flow dataset, E3Stereo reduces end-point error (EPE) at depth boundaries by 9.5%-14.3% across RAFT-Stereo, IGEV, and MonSter, while also reducing overall EPE. After fine-tuning, our IGEV-based model improves upon IGEV on all eleven reported metrics across ETH3D, KITTI 2012, and KITTI 2015. The source code will be made publicly available upon acceptance.

papers.title_en: Single Camera based Simulation and Try-on Ready Avatar Modeling
papers.authors: Honghu Chen, Bo Peng, Jun Xiang, Jingtao Zhou, Xujing Chen, Juyong Zhang
papers.evidence: 从单目视频或图像重建三维服装人体模型，属于表面与形状重建
papers.tldr: 仅凭单摄像头重建高保真、可动画且可试穿的虚拟人，仍受衣物与人体运动差异、单视角覆盖不足等因素制约。本文提出物理整合的双层 GS-Mesh，分别表示衣物与底层人体，并可利用二维生成数据补足观测信息。针对生成视频的帧间几何和外观不一致，方法借助三维表示实现一致重建与连贯渲染。结果支持新视角、新姿态动画及视觉可信的试穿布料动态，为单摄像头虚拟试穿提供了新方案。
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing and rendering high-fidelity, animatable, and try-on-ready virtual avatars using only a single camera is crucial for many applications. However, existing try-on-ready human avatar reconstruction methods struggle to achieve this from monocular videos or single images, primarily due to two issues: (1) existing approaches typically use a single layer to represent both garments and the underlying body, ignoring their distinct motion characteristics; and (2) input captured from a single camera often fails to fully cover both the garments and the underlying body. To address these challenges, we propose a physically integrated, double-layer GS-Mesh representation for reconstructing decoupled 3D clothed human avatars from monocular videos or even single images by incorporating 2D generated data. While 2D generation methods can produce video sequences from given pose sequences, they struggle to maintain inter-frame consistency. We decompose the inter-frame inconsistencies in the generated data into geometric and appearance inconsistencies. Based on our 3D representation, we ensure that the final reconstruction and rendering results are both 3D-consistent and temporally coherent. Compared with existing 3D garment transfer methods that rely on multi-view reconstruction and most 2D approaches that use diffusion models for image-based garment editing without novel-view or novel-pose synthesis, our method requires only a monocular video or even a single image while producing visually plausible cloth dynamics during virtual try-on and novel-pose animation. This represents a significant advancement toward virtual try-on with visually plausible cloth dynamics using only a single camera.

papers.title_en: No Cones, No Duals: A Fast and Scalable Solver for NRSfM
papers.authors: Suryansh Kumar
papers.evidence: 从二维轨迹恢复相机运动与时变三维形状
papers.tldr: 非刚性结构恢复需从连续二维轨迹同时估计相机运动与时变三维形状，现有高性能方法常依赖半正定锥优化和交替方向乘子法，在长序列与密集轨迹下计算昂贵。本文以可微欧氏校正和行极投影估计相机，再用展开式谱近端求解器结合重投影梯度、加权奇异值收缩及加速重启恢复低秩形状。方法无需外部训练数据、类别无关，并适配加速器线性代数。在多类基准中精度有竞争力，密集序列最高提速达7至1000倍，显著提升大规模求解的可扩展性。
papers.abstract_en: Non-rigid structure from motion (NRSfM) aims to recover camera motion and time-varying 3D shape from tracked 2D image measurements. Recent high-performing methods show that shape-space factorization remains highly effective for this task. These methods often use costly solvers for two key steps. First, a semidefinite programming (SDP) cone solver to perform Euclidean correction. Next, an alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM) solver to recover the low-rank shape. These steps often scale poorly to long sequences and dense point tracks. We propose a fast, scalable NRSfM solver that avoids these costly steps. For rotation estimation, we introduce a differentiable Euclidean correction that directly optimizes small factors for each sequence. A row-polar projection then maps each estimated camera block to the closest row-orthonormal matrix. For shape estimation, we introduce an unrolled spectral-proximal solver. It combines reprojection-gradient steps with weighted singular-value shrinkage in the reshuffled shape domain. This solver further uses FISTA-style restart and continuation. The spectral shrinkage operator itself is classical, but we embed it in a fixed differentiable solver, while preserving NRSfM's geometric constraints. The proposed approach is category-agnostic, requires no external training data, and maps naturally to modern accelerator-friendly linear algebra primitives. Across sparse, dense, noisy, missing-data, and long-sequence benchmarks, our solver achieves substantial speedups with competitive reconstruction accuracy, including 7x-1000x runtime improvements on dense sequences with 28,887 tracked points.

papers.title_en: DimFlow: Bidirectional Grid-Expert Learning for Dynamic Gaussian Reconstruction
papers.authors: Gabriel Adineera, Jinoh Kim
papers.evidence: 提出多分辨率特征学习以提升动态场景重建
papers.tldr: 动态高斯重建需要紧凑场景特征协同表达几何与外观变化，但多分辨率网格即使插值准确，也难保证属性在时空中的兼容性。DimFlow让网格与坐标专家分支双向交互，结合特征对抗对齐、自适应融合和激活掩码残差反馈，并由四类属性专家处理变形、旋转、不透明度及时间信息。跨D-NeRF、HyperNeRF和DAVIS汇总评测中，模型取得39.73 dB PSNR，比4D-GS高1.92 dB，同时保持85 FPS，模型大小18.9 MB。消融结果表明对齐、信息交换与时间处理贡献互补，为高质量且实时的动态高斯重建提供了紧凑特征学习方案。
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic Gaussian reconstruction requires compact scene features to support coordinated changes in geometry and appearance. A factorized grid provides efficient local queries, but accurate interpolation alone does not ensure that the resulting dynamic attributes remain compatible across space and time. We introduce DimFlow, a framework that learns these features through bidirectional interaction between a multi-resolution grid and a coordinate-based expert branch. Feature-level adversarial alignment connects their distributions, adaptive fusion transfers complementary information, and activation-masked residual feedback refines the grid during training. Four attribute experts organize deformation, rotation, opacity, and temporal information before Gaussian rendering. In the aggregate comparison across D-NeRF, HyperNeRF, and DAVIS, DimFlow achieves 39.73 dB PSNR, improving on 4D-GS by 1.92 dB while matching its reported 85 FPS rendering speed. The model occupies 18.9 MB, compared with 18.3 MB for 4D-GS. Component and attribute-expert ablations reveal complementary contributions from feature alignment, adaptive exchange, and temporal processing.

papers.title_en: DUET4D: Self-Corrective Coupled Guidance for Sparse-View 4D Reconstruction
papers.authors: Beizhen Zhao, Nanjie Yao, Boyi Fu, Qingsong Yan, Haofan Ren, Kaiyong Zhao, Hao Wang
papers.evidence: 针对稀疏视角四维场景重建，以自校正引导改善高斯表示
papers.tldr: 稀疏相机下的四维重建约束不足，生成先验虽能补全缺失外观，却面临计算开销高、时序不一致及伪观测污染高斯表示等问题。DUET4D提出自纠正耦合引导框架，让当前四维高斯表示为生成恢复提供时空一致的证据。它通过序列对齐引导潜在恢复，并以序列保真重采样筛选反复获支持的基元，再将纠正后的表示用于下一轮。实验表明，该方法显著改善渲染质量与效率，为稀疏视角四维重建提供迭代优化思路。
papers.abstract_en: Sparse-view 4D reconstruction is highly under-constrained when only a few cameras are available. Generative priors can recover missing appearances, but video models are computationally impractical for iterative reconstruction, whereas single-view models produce temporally inconsistent pseudo-observations. Moreover, directly absorbing uncertain generative outputs into Gaussian optimization often creates redundant primitives and floating artifacts. To address these challenges, we propose DUET4D, a self-corrective coupled guidance framework for sparse-view 4D Gaussian splatting. The core of our approach is a self-corrective framework where the 4D representation guides generative prior for spatio-temporal consistent supervisions. We first construct sequential alignments from current Gaussian evidence to steer the latent restoration. Then we use Sequential Fidelity Resampling to lift generative supervisions into Gaussian space to selectively distinguish repeatedly supported primitives. The corrected representation then provides more reliable Gaussian evidence for the next restoration cycle. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DUET4D significantly improves rendering quality and rendering efficiency.

papers.title_en: Surface matching for image-derived geometries with a projection-based separation of rigid body modes
papers.authors: Ludwig Wagmüller, Christian Bilas, Markus Gitterle, Michael Wibmer, Michael W. Gee
papers.evidence: 提出图像几何表面的匹配与形状变形分解方法
papers.tldr: LDDMM 表面匹配可建立平滑、可逆的非刚性映射，但影像采集时的物体摆位等因素也会引入刚体运动，干扰对真实形状差异的分析。本文在表面匹配中加入适当投影，将计算形变唯一分解为刚体运动模式与剔除刚体成分后的运动。小规模示例、单对心脏几何及98个心脏形状的队列展示了该方法的效果。分离两类运动既便于聚焦分析，也有助于保持表面离散质量。
papers.abstract_en: The large diffeomorphic deformation metric mapping (LDDMM) framework offers numerous techniques for analyzing shapes and images.   Surface matching computes a non-rigid, smooth, and invertible mapping that registers one surface to another.   The computed deformation may contain rigid body motion, which frequently does not represent meaningful shape differences but is due to external factors like imaging modalities, such as the object's positioning during image acquisition.   We present a simple extension to the LDDMM framework's surface matching that uniquely decomposes the computed deformation into rigid body modes (RBM) and RBM-free motion by introducing a suitable projection.   This enables a focused analysis of each component individually and additionally helps to preserve the surface discretization quality. Three sets of examples illustrate our approach.   A small-scale example demonstrates the proposed method's effects, followed by an example using a single pair of heart geometries, and finally an example involving a cohort of 98 heart shapes.

papers.title_en: Foundation Model Driven Optical Flow
papers.authors: Praroop Chanda, Suryansh Kumar
papers.evidence: 采用Transformer匹配流程融合视觉与深度表征进行稠密光流估计
papers.tldr: 稠密光流要求模型为图像像素建立准确对应，论文考察冻结的视觉与深度基础表征能否帮助监督式匹配网络。方法融合 DINOv2 和 Depth Anything V2 特征，采用 DPT 解码、可训练变换器匹配，并加入一次由粗到细的细化。模型在 FlyingChairs 与 FlyingThings3D 上训练，在 Sintel 训练集 Final 的端点误差为 2.37，低于文中 FlowSeek（T）的 2.52。RoCo-Spring 2026 参赛系统取得 1.1038 的鲁棒性平衡分，整体结果展示了复用冻结骨干构建光流流程的可行性。
papers.abstract_en: We investigate how frozen pretrained visual and depth representations support dense optical flow when coupled with a supervised matching network. Building on TTSFlow, this paper studies Dense Prediction Transformer (DPT) feature decoding and one coarse-to-fine refinement stage. Our method fuses features from frozen DINOv2 and Depth Anything V2 models and estimates optical flow through a trainable transformer-based matching pipeline. After optical-flow training on FlyingChairs and FlyingThings3D, it achieves 2.37 endpoint error (EPE) on the Sintel training split, Final pass, compared with 2.52 for the FlowSeek (T) configuration reported here. Our RoCo-Spring 2026 entry, RoCo-29.VSAI, obtains a robustness-balanced score of 1.1038, Spring EPE of 1.411, and RobustSpring proxy EPE of 4.739, with a lower balanced score than seven of the twelve listed reference baselines. These results characterize the complete pipeline, which reuses frozen foundation backbones and performs one refinement stage. Code is available at: \url{https://github.com/Visual-and-Spatial-AI-Lab/FFlow}

papers.title_en: MoRE: Motion-Regularized Encoding for Articulated 3D Generation
papers.authors: Guantian Zheng, Shan Jin
papers.evidence: 关节式三维对象生成及运动机制建模
papers.tldr: 单张图像生成可动三维物体，不仅要恢复外观与部件，还需准确刻画关节机制及其运动；仅压缩关节属性并不能保证重建后的动作正确。MoRE以坐标对齐的关节线编码消除轴上原点的任意性，并通过移动三维锚点、匹配标注运动，将关节属性学习与运动效果耦合。模型结合图像条件流学习功能潜变量，并用多状态适配高斯模型表示外观；推理时以同一组静止姿态高斯表示生成各状态。在PartNet-Mobility和ACD上的实验显示，MoRE提升了部件框、运动状态几何及视觉相似度，关节预测也优于ArtiLatent，说明运动正则有助于更可靠地生成可动三维物体。
papers.abstract_en: Generating an articulated object from a single image requires recovering both its appearance and the mechanism governing its parts. A compact encoding of joint attributes does not by itself ensure that reconstruction preserves the resulting motion. We present MoRE, Motion-Regularized Encoding for articulated 3D generation. MoRE represents coordinate-aligned joint lines with axis classification and two axis-orthogonal Plücker moment coefficients, removing the arbitrary choice of an origin along the axis. During representation learning, decoded joint hypotheses are used to move corresponding three-dimensional anchors, and their motions are compared with those of annotated joints. A differentiable expectation over joint types and axis directions couples attribute reconstruction to the motion it induces. An image-conditioned flow learns the resulting functional latents, while a multi-state-adapted Gaussian model supplies appearance. At inference, recovered part assignments and joints articulate a single set of rest-pose Gaussians without regenerating the object for each state. Experiments on PartNet-Mobility and ACD show stronger part-box agreement, articulated-state geometry and visual similarity than the compared baselines, while joint prediction reduces axis, origin and range errors relative to ArtiLatent. Controlled ablations support the joint-line encoding and show that motion supervision reduces anchor-motion error. Code and pretrained checkpoints will be released in the future.

papers.title_en: Segmentation of Moving Objects During Camera Motion Using the OWL Function
papers.authors: Daniel Raviv, Juan D. Yepes
papers.evidence: 依据视觉运动与相对三维结构线索分割独立运动物体
papers.tldr: 在相机运动且场景含多个独立运动刚体时，仅凭图像运动线索可靠分割仍具挑战，传统方案常依赖深度、训练数据或语义先验。本文以 OWL 感知函数统一表征感知逼近量 L 与感知旋转 ω，并用四元数将其二维复数形式推广到三维单相机情形。由 L、ω 可逐像素解析恢复相对平移方向；同一非旋转刚体上的点共享该方向，不同刚体通常取值不同。对方向估计聚类即可划分运动物体，方法支持并行计算且对相机旋转不敏感，为无需深度和先验的运动分割提供解析框架。
papers.abstract_en: We present a principled, analytical framework for segmenting multiple independently moving rigid objects during single camera motion, built directly upon the OWL perception function. OWL encodes two fundamental visual motion cues, perceived looming $L$ and perceived rotation $ω$, into a single closed-form representation of relative 3D structure. A key consequence of this structure is that the unit direction of relative translation $\hat{t}$ is analytically recoverable per image point from $L$ and $ω$ alone. All points belonging to a non-rotating rigid body share the same $\hat{t}$, whereas points on different rigid bodies generally yield distinct values. This furnishes a natural segmentation criterion: clustering per-point $\hat{t}$ estimates partitions the visible scene into independently moving rigid bodies. Building on the 2D complex form of OWL, we derive the framework in 3D using quaternions, for a single moving camera. The approach is parallel, camera rotation-invariant, and requires no training data, no depth information, and no semantic priors.

papers.title_en: Fovea-JEPA: Overcoming Geometric Blind Spots in V-JEPA for Camera Motion Recognition
papers.authors: Xiangkun Shi, Hanhui Li, Shiyue Zhang, Chang Liu, Junwen Pan, Zhenbang Sun, Xiaodan Liang
papers.evidence: 利用几何线索改善相机运动识别，涉及几何视觉与相机运动估计
papers.tldr: 相机运动识别需要区分镜头平移、旋转或变焦造成的视点变化与物体运动，而视频模型常难捕捉几何证据。研究发现，V-JEPA存在局部几何盲点，时间反转监督虽提升整体表现，却会损害部分运动类别。为此，Fovea-JEPA以VGGT预测误差构造伪标签，定位盲点并按需融合几何与视觉特征。在三个基准上，它较此前最优基线分别提升9.67、8.67和24.38个百分点，证明选择性引入几何信息可增强识别。
papers.abstract_en: Camera motion recognition requires separating viewpoint changes caused by camera translation, rotation, or zoom from object motion and scene dynamics. Video-language models often rely on semantic cues and struggle with the geometric evidence needed for this task. Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures such as V-JEPA offer strong spatio-temporal representations, but our experiments suggest that they underrepresent geometric cues in some regions. Under temporal-reversal supervision, V-JEPA improves overall but degrades on several motion families, whereas a weaker geometry-oriented VGGT predictor improves across all families. We refer to these geometrically underrepresented regions as geometric blind spots and propose Fovea-JEPA to identify and address them. Using V-JEPA as the base model and VGGT as a geometry expert, we construct intervention pseudo-labels from their prediction errors to weakly supervise a blind-spot predictor. The predictor produces token-wise response maps, which are aggregated into a clip-level intervention score to guide adaptive fusion of visual and geometric features. This selective intervention introduces complementary geometric information while preserving reliable visual predictions. Experiments on CameraMotionDataset, CameraBench, and ShotBench demonstrate the effectiveness of Fovea-JEPA, with gains of 9.67, 8.67, and 24.38 percentage points over previously reported state-of-the-art baselines, respectively. Code and models will be released upon acceptance.
